No React 'Cannot read property' / 'undefined is not an object' / red-screen errors were emitted during the full flow. Console noise (53 entries) is exclusively net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED / ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED / 404 from upstream http:// logo URLs (onerestream.us, novatv.us) — pre-existing Mixed-Content cosmetic issue on the HTTPS web preview, does not affect the native APK and unrelated to this fix.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: previous implementation initialised `active` with 'ALL' as the useState default. The first loadChannels effect therefore fired immediately with cat='ALL' (fetching the full 3867-channel list). loadCats then completed a moment later and called setActive(tvChile.id=3) which triggered a SECOND loadChannels(3, …). Because of network jitter the ALL response occasionally arrived AFTER the TV-CHILE response, so the stale 3867-channel list clobbered the fresh 39-channel list and the tab appeared to 'not load' the intended TV CHILE channels (or displayed 3867 with no error). Fix: (1) initial `active` is now empty string; (2) the loadChannels useEffect early-returns while `active === ''`; (3) loadCats sets active to the found TV CHILE id (or 'ALL' fallback) and toggles a ref so subsequent focuses preserve the user's choice. This makes the auto-select deterministic and one-shot. Verified: header count is '39 canales' on first load, chip-3 is white/active, and TVN/MEGA/CHV rows render — the exact expected UX.
